in bibliotheca Veneta D' Marci in cod. 324 „ (Fabricius-Harles, IV, p. 152). Excerpta

in codd. Marc. 335, f. 244r, 356r; Marc. 336, f. 278r; Taurin., CVIII, 10, f. 7r. Adde Vin-
dob., 47 [Lambecius, Comm., t. VIII, p. 193], Paris. 2419, f. 140v, Neapol. II, c. 33,

sections.en: 1 " There exists in the Imperial library [Vindob. 134 and 135] a commentary of Heliodorus on the astrological doctrine of Paulus divided into fifty-three chapters... It is also in the Venetian library of St. Mark in cod. 324 " (Fabricius-Harles, IV, p. 152). Excerpts from this commentary are not rarely found, as Kroll noted (Philologus, 1898, p. 129) e. g. in codd. Marc. 335, f. 244r, 356r; Marc. 336, f. 278r; Taurin., CVIII, 10, f. 7r. Add Vin- dob., 47 [Lambecius, Comm., t. VIII, p. 193], Paris. 2419, f. 140v, Neapol. II, c. 33, f. 521v, and see below, cod. 12, f. 164. — On the age of Heliodorus, cf. below, at cod. 11, f. 261.

summary.headline: Astrological Topics, Chapters 250–266
summary.text: Chapter list covering the lord of the year, Nechepso’s month, Heliodorus’s astrological commentary on aspects, applications and separations, signs, phases, stations, lots, and the twelfth-part of the stars. It then begins a second section on the twelve places and lists topics including children, action, and centers, succedents, and cadents.
